Overview

Job Title: Physics Subject Matter Expert – AI Training & Content Development

About Innodata : Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a global leader in data engineering and AI-powered solutions, working with 4 of the top 5 global technology companies and over 2,000 enterprise clients worldwide. Operating in 13 global locations with a workforce of 5,000+ subject matter experts, Innodata leads innovation in ML, NLP, and LLM training. By combining cutting-edge AI technology, deep domain expertise, and secure infrastructure, Innodata delivers transformative solutions that power the next generation of intelligent systems.

About the Role

We are seeking a Physics Subject Matter Expert (SME) with exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and writing skills to join our AI / LLM training team. You will play a crucial role in developing, curating, and evaluating advanced physics content to enhance AI models’ reasoning, accuracy, and ability to explain complex physics concepts. This role is ideal for physicists, researchers, and academics passionate about science communication and AI innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Content Development :

  • Create high-quality physics datasets, including conceptual explanations of physics principles (classical, quantum, and modern physics).
  • Problem sets and numerical solutions.
  • Detailed derivations of equations and laws.
  • Technical summaries and scientific research briefs.
  • Build domain-specific datasets across physics subfields such as Mechanics, Thermodynamics, and Electromagnetism; Quantum Mechanics, Particle Physics, and Nuclear Physics; Astrophysics, Relativity, and Cosmology; Materials Science and Condensed Matter Physics; Computational Physics and Applied Physics.

Model Evaluation & AI Training :

  • Evaluate LLM-generated physics content for accuracy, clarity, rigor, and logical reasoning.
  • Detect and correct conceptual gaps, numerical errors, and inconsistencies in AI outputs.
  • Help define data quality standards and evaluation rubrics for scientific reasoning.

Collaboration & R&D :

  • Work closely with AI engineers, computational linguists, and data scientists to improve AI reasoning.
  • Provide domain expertise for designing AI benchmarks and test scenarios.
  • Contribute to research on physics education, simulation modeling, and AI-assisted scientific research.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Master’s or PhD in Physics, Applied Physics, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline (PhD preferred).
  • Strong foundation in theoretical and applied physics.
  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more areas: Computational modeling, simulations, or numerical methods.
  • Advanced topics (e.g., quantum field theory, condensed matter, astrophysics).
  • Proven experience in academic publishing, science communication, or curriculum design.
  • Strong technical writing skills and ability to explain complex concepts clearly.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with AI / ML models, data annotation, and prompt engineering (bonus).
  • Experience in LaTeX, Python, or scientific computing tools.
  • Knowledge of AI fairness and bias detection in STEM datasets.

Why Join Innodata?

  • Shape the future of AI by embedding physics expertise into large-scale models.
  • Collaborate with top-tier researchers and engineers globally.
  • Influence next-gen AI capabilities in scientific reasoning.
  • Work remotely with flexibility and innovation-driven teams.

Additional Information

  • Candidates must complete an English Language Assessment.
  • Mandatory and non-billable step.

title: Developer Advocate - Remote
description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data use.

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 2,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

About the role

You’re a natural bridge between technology and people—a communicator who thrives on making complex topics clear, exciting, and accessible. You have a genuine passion for empowering developers, backed by hands-on technical expertise and a curiosity that keeps you experimenting with new tools, frameworks, and ideas. You’re equally at home coding up a quick demo as you are standing on stage, streaming live, or publishing a deep-dive article. You believe in community as more than just a buzzword — it’s about fostering connections, listening with intent, and inspiring others to build.

As a Developer Advocate at Zyte, you’ll champion our web scraping and data extraction tools to developers around the world, shaping how they learn, adopt, and innovate with our technology. You’ll create projects, stories, and resources that highlight the power of Zyte API and Scrapy, connecting with our audience across events, social channels, and developer communities. You’ll work closely with product and marketing teams, bringing community insights back into our roadmap, while amplifying the voices of developers who use our tools. Your work will make a tangible impact—growing awareness, deepening trust, and helping Zyte define the Web Scraping API category

Responsibilities

  • Create content (written, video, webinars) and code samples that demonstrate how to work with and integrate Zyte tools.
  • Engage with the community across social channels and forums and showcase how to solve web scraping challenges
  • Educate, showcase and demo our products to our communities and beyond
  • Speak at developer-focused events
  • Write blog posts for Zyte and third-party sites.
  • Identify external advocates and community leaders, and support them as they talk about Zyte and web data extraction independent of us.
  • Represent the developer POV in the marketing team.
  • Work with our technical teams to identify content opportunities and channel community feedback
  • Identify opportunities to improve documentation and be an active contributor
  • Post regularly on the company’s social channels for our developer audience

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in developer advocacy, community engagement, or related technical roles
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, APIs, web scraping, and data extraction
  • Demonstrable knowledge of Python.
  • Interest in web data extraction
  • A passion for developers and helping developers.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with some experience with public speaking
  • Proven experience working with communities, social media, and blogging required.
  • A background in community building and event hosting is a plus
  • Self-motivated, self-reliant and able to prioritize tasks.
  • Strong team player

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Scrapy, headless browsers and web scraping is a plus but not a hard requirement.

As a new Zytan, you will

  • Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.
  • Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.
  • Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.
  • Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.
  • 35 days paid holidays

About GrowthX AI

At GrowthX, we design growth systems that integrate AI automation and expert guidance to help marketing teams with content creation, distribution, and conversion. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and other designers to take ideas from concept to completion, ensuring a seamless and intuitive user experience across all GrowthX products.

Your work will directly impact businesses, making AI more accessible, powerful, and easy to use. You'll push boundaries and set new standards in how companies leverage AI for growth, driving both visual and functional improvements across the GrowthX ecosystem.

You'll have opportunities to lead, propose, and execute projects across various products and tools. Whether refining designs, optimizing workflows, enhancing user interfaces, or launching new features, your contributions will shape our platform's future.

Requirements

We Need:

  • Design Expertise: Proven experience in creating user-friendly interfaces with a strong portfolio showcasing digital product design. Ability to adapt to different design styles as necessary.

  • Problem-Solver: Creative thinking to address complex design challenges.

  • "Demo Over Essay": Ability to align teams with working prototypes, user flows, or high-fidelity mockups, choosing the most effective communication method.

  • Resistance to Feedback: Comfort with iterating based on feedback, data, and testing is key.

  • Inflexibility: This role requires adaptability to changing requirements and team dynamics.

  • Low Initiative: If you need constant direction and lack proactivity, this environment won't suit you.

Day-to-Day Expectations: Here's how you can expect to spend your time each week:

  • 35% – Feature Development : Building and implementing frontend components, features, and interactions using modern web technologies.

  • 25% – Design Development : Creating wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that you'll help implement.

  • 20% – Technical Collaboration : Working with full-stack engineers to integrate your frontend work with backend systems.

  • 10% – Research & Testing : Conducting technical feasibility assessments and user tests, then implementing feedback.

  • 5% – Design & Code Reviews : Participating in team reviews to ensure quality and consistency in both design and implementation.

  • 5% – Continuous Improvement : Staying updated on design and development trends, exploring new technologies and best practices for ongoing professional growth.

Collaborative Culture

  • Open communication & feedback-driven environment.

title: Senior Network Planning Manager, Emerging Country Network Topology Planning
description:
Overview

The Emerging Country Network Topology Planning team is looking for a talented Senior Network Planning Manager who will create solutions to optimize multi-year and multi-echelon network topology design, along with supply chain planning and capacity design processes. Team scope includes emerging countries long-term network topology and strategic planning for Mexico, Brazil, Australia, Middle East, Turkey, South Africa, Singapore and other new countries.

As a team player you will work with some of the best supply chain professionals, tech teams, worldwide engineers, operations managers, finance partners, and business leaders across continents to design optimal supply chain network solutions. The objective is to solve conflicting objectives and achieve the best customer experience in the most cost-efficient way. You will work with cross-functional teams across countries to define requirements, develop FC (fulfillment center) topology and network solutions, and manage timelines for current and future projects. The role also involves collaborating with Global Engineering Services, Design Engineers, PMO and tech teams to optimize capacity and expand the fulfillment centers network in emerging countries.

This position involves regular communication with senior management on status, risks/opportunities, and daily change control management. It requires cross-team coordination, project management, and executive interaction skills, as well as strong stakeholder management, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate in a fast-paced environment. Candidates should be adept at diving deep into information sources and working with engineering teams, technology partners, local/regional operations, and finance teams to rapidly iterate and deliver solutions. The role requires engagement across various teams to drive long-term strategic initiatives and adoption of best practices.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead network planning and capacity design projects with cross-functional teams focused on network expansion that meets cost optimization and speed acceleration goals.
  • Coordinate and gather requirements from multiple partner teams to develop long-term solutions for a 3–5 year planning horizon.
  • Communicate and drive long-term initiatives, remove bottlenecks, and create scalable mechanisms; use supply chain knowledge to influence process enhancements.
  • Influence stakeholders without direct authority; provide clear, precise, and regular communication with stakeholders, including ongoing project/program status via monthly and quarterly planning reviews.
  • Identify gaps and opportunities in processes; partner with established markets teams to benchmark best practices and drive adoption for emerging countries.
  • Contribute to mid- to long-term capacity design, process standardization, and development of innovative solutions for new and existing emerging countries.
  • Travel approximately 25% annually to respective countries to connect with local partners and learn local operations.

About the team

The Emerging Country Long-Term Network Topology and Supply Chain Planning team works to optimize multi-year and multi-echelon network topology strategy, along with supply chain planning processes for nine emerging countries. Team scope includes network planning for Mexico, Brazil, Australia, Middle East (AE, KSA, EG), Turkey, South Africa and Singapore, with additional new countries to come with further international expansion.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including pivot tables, macros, index/match, VLOOKUP, VBA, data links, etc.
  • Experience in supply chain, network capacity planning and long-term planning.
  • Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization.
  • Master’s degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field.
  • Experience with Six Sigma/Lean, statistical data analysis, network modeling and operational excellence.
  • Ability to write SQL/Python queries and use BI tools like Tableau/Power BI.
  • Knowledge of how a fulfillment center and transportation network are designed and operated.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate both strategically and tactically in a high-energy, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to juggle multiple competing priorities and create a sense of urgency in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Additional information

Overview

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub! We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Mid-level Backend Software Engineer in our Unverified Partner Content team in Brazil !

This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

We are looking for a passionate and skilled Software Engineer to join our team and help us build the next generation of AI-powered solutions by providing high-quality data to power the engine of Wellhub’s generative AI product and provide partner data to all areas of the company. You will join a team responsible for building and maintaining a comprehensive database of information on our existing and potential partners. This includes discovering and collecting data from various sources and formats (text, photo, video, audio), processing and enriching this data, and transforming it into actionable insights that enhance partner content, user recommendations, business intelligence, and the overall quality of our platform. We expect all candidates to be avid learners, team workers, and not afraid to fail fast and try again

Your Impact

You will be working in one or more of the following areas:

  • Third-Party API Integration: REST APIs (authentication via tokens, OAuth, etc.). Google Places API. Meta (Facebook Graph API). OpenStreetMap (Nominatim, Overpass API).
  • Data Processing & Transformation: Data handling and cleaning. Data validation and modeling.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Unit and integration testing. Mocking external APIs.
  • API Development and Integration: Design and develop APIs. Ensure APIs are secure, scalable, and performant. Ensure seamless integration with other software systems, enhancing interoperability and functionality (e.g., WhatsApp, Slack, Teams, Google Chat, and other 3rd party mobile applications).
  • Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineers. Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers. Communicate technical concepts and project progress effectively to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong skills in programming languages such as Python, Kotlin, or Go.
  • Experienced in working with SQL/NoSQL technologies (e.g., OpenSearch, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) understanding common use cases and performance pitfalls.
  • Experienced in working with message queues & async processing (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Experience with API development and integration.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Able to work efficiently on highly scalable and distributed projects.
  • Proven experience with projects with a more experimental scope.
  • Fast learner, easily adapting to new technologies.
  • Passionate and proven experience to build reliable minimum viable products and pilots.
  • Nice to have:
    • PhD degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
    • Proven experience with one or more topics listed above.
    • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
    • Experience with Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration.

For this specific role, prior experience coding with Python, Kotlin, or Golang, working with message queues & async processing are mandatory requirements.

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

  • CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.
  • CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. title: Engineering Manager- Ceph & Distributed Storage
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Ceph & Distributed Storage. The world creates more than 2.5 quintillion bytes of data every day. We want to help teams store data in open source storage on commodity hardware - safely, cheaply and simply. Our goal is to make Ceph easy to install, manage and use - from large enterprise data center installations to half-rack edge sites. We believe distributed storage shouldn't be hard and, to keep up with increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we’re excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.

What you'll do

  • You will lead a team building a Ceph focused software defined storage solution
  • You will build and manage a globally distributed team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possible; you love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

This is an opportunity to run a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. We are rapidly expanding the range of open source solutions we offer and deliver to customers, as we move into new industries like telco, finance, health care and media we design and develop new open source solutions to meet their needs.
We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team's direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.
We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.
The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical
The Field Engineering team is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.
A Cloud Field Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.
Location: This role will be home based, managing a team in your time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • Experience in technical presales
  • You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Passion and a track record of developing and growing people
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well

  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred

We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

description:
Overview

In this role, you will be at the forefront of embedding intelligent AI-powered agents into Salesforce environments, enhancing customer interactions, automating complex business processes, and optimizing user experiences. This role uniquely combines Salesforce expertise and passion for AI/Agentic-driven solutions. You will partner closely with customers, internal account teams, product experts, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex business needs into AI-driven Salesforce agents that deliver tangible, measurable business outcomes. You will analyze requirements, design and implement intelligent Agentforce-powered agents within Salesforce, and continuously optimize the experience & performance to drive business value and consumption. The ideal candidate is customer-focused, self-driven, and excels in communication and collaboration. They should enjoy building relationships and quickly adapting to new technologies. This role suits individuals with strong technical skills who want to grow their careers at Salesforce and work with autonomous agent technologies. They will be the primary contact for helping customers activate, use, and expand Agentforce in their organizations.

Responsibilities

  • Assess technical and business readiness and map organizational processes through direct customer engagement
  • Lead the end-to-end design, configuration, and deployment of Agentforce agents within Salesforce; building agents that meet compliance requirements, business logic, and customer experience goals
  • Recommend opportunities to reengineer processes by combining AI agent capabilities with Salesforce automation tools such as Flows and OmniStudio.
  • Identify and provide recommendations on data strategy, data quality, governance (e.g., legal reviews, AI council), and software development lifecycle best practices.
  • Define and orchestrate agent actions, configure and maintain each agent’s topics, and create and optimize prompt engineering strategies to improve agent performance, relevance, and accuracy
  • Implement and configure leading large language models (LLMs) like GPT-4 for Salesforce agents
  • Perform testing and refinement in customer environment throughout deployment to optimize agent performance
  • Track performance metrics and user feedback; execute iterative improvements based on performance metrics to grow Agentforce consumption
  • Build and maintain knowledge bases and technical documentation for internal and customer use
  • Develop and implement standardized agent deployment processes; create and maintain integration patterns across Salesforce platforms
  • Deliver guidance on best practices to ensure customers can self-sustain their Agentforce implementation.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years experience with cloud based technologies and architecture principles
  • Advanced or expert knowledge of Salesforce and Agentforce and AI
  • Experienced with Data Cloud or similar data integration platforms
  • Other Salesforce Certs such as Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, or Sales Cloud
  • Solid understanding of AI concepts, especially conversational AI or intelligent agents.
  • Hands-on experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) or AI services into applications
  • Experience with AI orchestration frameworks or prompt engineering
  • Consistent proactive thinking and the desire to self-start on learning and applying new technologies.
  • Ability to design scalable solutions for complex business requirements.
  • Skilled in debugging, optimizing, and ensuring the reliability of integrated AI-Salesforce solutions.
  • Strong proficiency in Salesforce Flow, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, Salesforce APIs, and Agent Studio
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, ensuring minimal disruption to client operations.
  • Document technical processes, develop proofs of concept, and participate in Agile project planning.
  • Advise on best practices for application development, integration, and technical architecture.

description:
Company Description

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. What you get to do in this role

About Grupo QuintoAndar: We are the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diversified portfolio of brands and solutions across different countries in Latin America, covering all phases of the housing journey. We also have a Technology Hub in Portugal. We develop technology and innovation to transform and enhance the overall living experience.

Location & Remote Work: Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

Hiring Process Stages: The stages of our hiring processes aim to assess your experiences and allow you to meet our teams and explore career opportunities. They are structured as follows:

  • Application
  • Interview with Recruiter
  • Tech Screening
  • Technical Interview with Data Products Team
  • Offer

About the Area: In our Data Science team, you will work as part of product squads delivering features that enrich our product and provide a first-class experience. You will collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, UX Writers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Software Engineers, and others. Responsibilities include solving hard problems, high standards, and meaningful collaboration. Specific problems include search and recommendation systems; customer experience improvements using ML (e.g., automatic routing of tickets); pricing, liquidity and credit models; and building a platform to develop and deploy these solutions.

Note: This is a senior position. We expect at least 3+ years of experience applying data science and building machine learning models. If you are early in your Data Science journey, please apply to the Data Scientist role instead.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop and deploy machine learning systems to production. Main use cases include chatbots and search.
  • Design and execute experiments.
  • Analyze a wide variety of data (structured and unstructured, observational and experimental) to improve current models or create new ones.
  • Apply the scientific method to develop LLM-powered applications, including testing prompts, evaluating LLM capabilities, assessing AI guardrails, and building PoCs to validate generative AI for product features.
  • Participate in Data Science chapter activities (Guilds, Design Reviews, Demos, etc.).

What we are looking for:

  • People who seek to learn and deliver real impact through Data Science
  • Expert knowledge of ML concepts: regression, classification, clustering, neural networks, feature selection, cross-validation, bias-variance tradeoff, model explainability, etc.
  • Good understanding of engineering challenges to deploy ML systems to production
  • Proficiency in Python
  • Some knowledge or experience with Deep Learning
  • Experience with technical leadership for other data scientists
  • Excellent written and verbal technical communication skills; passion for sharing knowledge within the Data Science Chapter
  • Good English skills (verbal and written) are mandatory

Nice to have:

  • A MSc (or Undergraduate + intensive experience) in ML, DS, IR, ranking systems, recommender systems, NLP, or similar fields
  • Experience with applied generative AI: AI agents, prompt engineering, LLM fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT), LLM routing, LLM monitoring, LLM guardrails
  • Experience working in fast-growing startups

Important

  • Our hiring process starts with the application. We analyze all candidates and provide feedback to all applicants.
  • All communications will be via email. Please monitor for messages and ensure emails from @quintoandar.com.br are not marked as spam.

description:
Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro.A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área defisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Avaliar, incrementar e fortalecer fatores de proteção que permitam ampliação da resiliência dos pacientes e familiares frente às situações emergenciais que chegam ao Serviço de Psicologia Hospitalar através das solicitações dos integrantes da equipe de saúde

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Psicologia
  • Pós Graduação Completa em uma ou mais áreas citadas a seguir: Neuropsicologia, Psicanálise, Psicologia Humanista e Abordagem Centrada na Pessoa, Psicoterapia Cognitivo - Comportamental da Infância e Adolescência, Psicologia Clínica, Psicologia Social, Psicologia Psicomotricidade,Estratégia Saúde da Família ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Psicólogo.

Local de Trabalho: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Carga Horária: 30H (diurno e noturno) e 40H (diarista)

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: mbar Energia - Operador Usina Termoelétrica
description:
Overview

Âmbar Energia é a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F. Possuímos um portfólio diversificado com usinas hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e a biogás, atuando na expansão da matriz energética do Brasil. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada, com 39 unidades de geração e atuação na gestão de contas para clientes de todos os portes. O grupo J&F está presente em mais de 190 países e tem uma história de 70 anos, com portfólio que inclui JBS, Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em expansão e buscamos profissional para atuar como Operador Usina Termoelétrica em nossa usina em Santa Cruz, RJ. O objetivo é executar as atividades de operação dos turbogeradores a gás e vapor, caldeiras de recuperação de calor, estação de tratamento de água e desmineralização, estação de tratamento de efluentes, subestação e demais sistemas auxiliares, assegurando o despacho adequado e a disponibilidade da planta de forma segura e confiável.

Responsibilities

  • Executar as rotinas operacionais (testes funcionais, rondas, preenchimento de relatórios, relacionamento com os agentes ONS, Energisa e Eletronorte), de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-01, visando assegurar que as rotinas são executadas dentro dos padrões de qualidade e segurança da empresa.
  • Executar a operação e conservação do ciclo combinado, de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-08, cumprindo com o programa de geração estabelecido pelo ONS, a fim de garantir a disponibilidade da planta.
  • Executar a operação e conservação das turbinas a gás e seus auxiliares, de forma remota (supervisório na sala de controle) e local (em campo), de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-09, de forma confiável e segura, visando cumprir com a disponibilidade da planta, através de um índice de controle e com os requisitos de qualidade de emissões atmosféricas exigidos no processo, evitando danos aos equipamentos.
  • Executar a operação e conservação das caldeiras (HRSG) e seus auxiliares, de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-10, de forma confiável e segura visando assegurar o bom funcionamento dos equipamentos em geral para geração de energia.
  • Executar a operação e conservação do ciclo água-vapor, de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-11, visando cumprir com os requisitos de qualidade de água e vapor exigidos no processo, necessários para a vida útil das caldeiras.
  • Executar a operação e conservação da turbina a vapor e seus auxiliares, de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-12, visando cumprir com a disponibilidade da planta e com os requisitos de qualidade de vapor exigidos.
  • Executar a operação e conservação da planta de desmineralização de água (DESMI), de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-13, visando cumprir com os requisitos de qualidade de água necessários para a vida útil das caldeiras.
  • Executar a operação e conservação da estação de tratamento de água (ETA), de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-14, de forma confiável e segura visando cumprir com os requisitos de qualidade de água exigidos para a vida útil da torre de resfriamento e do condensador da turbina a vapor.
  • Executar a operação e conservação da planta de óleo combustível (descarregamento, tratamento e armazenagem), de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-15, de forma confiável e segura visando cumprir com os requisitos de qualidade de óleo exigidos para a vida útil das turbinas a gás e nível de emissões atmosféricas.
  • Executar a operação e conservação da estação de tratamento de efluentes (ETE), de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-16, de forma confiável e segura visando cumprir com os requisitos de qualidade de água estabelecidos pelo órgão ambiental.
  • Coletar amostras e encaminhar para análises químicas e, quando necessário, executar análises esporadicamente, para garantir os padrões de qualidade de água e vapor exigidos em todos os processos da planta, conforme P-OP-17.
  • Executar manobras nos barramentos elétricos da planta e preencher os relatórios, de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-OP-19, de forma confiável e segura visando cumprir com a disponibilidade da planta.
  • Auxiliar o supervisor de turno na execução de pequenas intervenções em equipamentos, visando garantir a disponibilidade da planta.
  • Realizar rondas na planta e informar as ocorrências ao supervisor de turno, para garantir que as ações corretivas sejam tomadas e manter a disponibilidade da planta.
  • Executar descarregamento de produtos químicos, de acordo com os procedimentos e instruções P-AL-05, de forma confiável e segura conforme os padrões de qualidade e segurança da empresa.
  • Realizar, quando necessário, o preenchimento dos livros de ocorrências da planta, visando a consistência dos relatos de ocorrências no respectivo turno.
  • Auxiliar o supervisor de turno na execução das isolations de equipamentos e sistemas (lock-out tag-out), conforme a instrução de segurança I-SE-0-2.16, assegurando a execução dos serviços dentro dos padrões de segurança da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Técnico Completo
  • Formação específica em Eletrônica, Mecânica, eletromecânica, eletrotécnica ou Química
  • Necessário experiência anterior como Operador em Usinas
  • Saber interpretar o diagrama elétrico unifilar da planta e identificar os principais barramentos (no diagrama e em campo), sua função e importância
  • Saber identificar as tubulações de vapor na caldeira, pipe-rack e turbina a vapor (HP, IP, LP, cold e hot re-heater)
  • Saber o KKS e a localização física das principais válvulas das caldeiras
  • Saber operar a estação de tratamento de água, incluindo controle analítico do processo (dosagem de químicos, qualidade da água, retrolavagem e tratamento de lodo)
  • Saber operar a planta de desmineralização de água, incluindo controle analítico do processo (dosagem de químicos, qualidade da água, regeneração e neutralização)
  • Saber realizar o alinhamento completo e coleta de amostras de água e vapor

Sobre a Just a Little Data / B>P

Só um pouquinho de dados. Ou um montão deles.

A quantidade não é o mais importante, mas sim o uso que fazemos das informações. Na Just a Little Data, nosso papel é exatamente este: ajudar empresas - sejam elas multinacionais ou negócios locais - a potencializar o conhecimento por trás dos dados.

Para isso, contamos não só com um time feito de especialistas em business, tecnologia, comunicação e outras áreas, mas com toda a estrutura e apoio do grupo B&Partners , do qual fazemos parte.

Queremos revolucionar o processo de tomada de decisão nas empresas e tornar a ciência de dados mais acessível, para que ela seja uma vantagem competitiva de negócios de diversos segmentos.

Nosso clima é de startup, com desafios, projetos e oportunidades de desenvolvimento constantes. Valorizamos a criatividade, unicidade de bagagem, bem estar e autonomia das pessoas que atuam conosco. Afinal, são elas que fazem a empresa, e não o contrário. Se curtiu a ideia de somar com a gente, veja nossas vagas em aberto - uma delas pode ser a sua cara. E o seu perfil, a nossa.

Solucionar problemas e direcionar operações com tecnologia e ciência de dados da maneira mais prática e objetiva visando aumentar os resultados dos nossos clientes e parceiros.

Assertividade e precisão na entrega.

Diversidade

Aqui na Just, respeitar as identidades e valores de cada indivíduo não é só uma questão fundamental, mas obrigatória. Acreditamos que contar com pessoas de todos os tipos no nosso time é exatamente o que precisamos para nos desenvolver em todos os sentidos. Por isso, diferentes visões, bagagens e modos de ser são e serão sempre bem-vindos na nossa casa.

Como parte do grupo, somos signatários do Pacto Global da ONU, e lideramos dois importantes movimentos: Elas Lideram 2030 e Raça é Prioridade. Isso se traduz em metas claras: 50% de lideranças femininas e 50% de pessoas negras em posições de liderança, reforçando nosso compromisso com equidade real e contínua.

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia com um equilíbrio que nos orgulha! Aqui, mulheres são maioria, provando que inovação e diversidade caminham juntas.

Bora somar e deixar os gráficos abaixo cada vez menos padronizados!

Nossa forma de trabalhar

Nossa forma de trabalhar é híbrida, mais para remota. Na Just, valorizamos o equilíbrio entre autonomia e alinhamento. Por isso, temos vagas remotas, híbridas e algumas que pedem presença em São Paulo, seja para encontros no escritório ou momentos conforme o escopo da vaga exigir. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Overview

Sequencing.com is on a mission to make advanced whole genome sequencing accessible and actionable for everyone. We’re a startup at the intersection of SaaS, eCommerce, and health tech - offering DNA testing kits, secure DNA data storage, and a growing marketplace of reports and proprietary AI tools that help people understand their genetic data. We’re looking for a customer-obsessed, data-savvy, and outcome-oriented Product Manager to bring structure to our roadmap and help us scale with purpose. This is a senior individual contributor role with high visibility and strategic impact. You’ll be responsible for managing high-impact product initiatives across the platform, driving execution from discovery through delivery. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high-ownership environment, demands excellence in execution, and leads with clarity and decisiveness. You must have a builder’s mentality and a proven track record of releasing successful consumer-facing products.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and Drive the Product Roadmap: Maintain and enforce a focused product roadmap across our core platform, ensuring clarity of scope, priority, and impact. Track all features, bugs, and enhancements across Engineering, Design, Bioinformatics, and Customer Success.
  • Lead Discovery & Customer Insight Work: Combine qualitative and quantitative approaches to deeply understand our customers. Actively engage with users through interviews, testing, and platform usage, while also analyzing product and behavioral data to uncover patterns, friction points, and opportunities. Use both first-hand insights and data-driven findings to anchor product direction in real customer needs and outcomes.
  • Define & Scope Features: Translate customer insights and company goals into actionable product plans with clear documentation, timelines, and success criteria. Ensure projects are aligned with what moves the needle.
  • Execution Leadership: Collaborate cross-functionally to scope, de-risk, and deliver high-quality features at startup speed. Push teams toward urgency and disciplined execution.
  • Documentation Ownership: Write and maintain detailed product specs, user flows, success metrics, and timelines in Confluence and Jira. Your documentation will be the single source of truth.
  • Jira & Process Stewardship: Own the ROAD Jira board, ensuring tickets are properly structured, linked, and prioritized. Proactively manage dependencies, identify blockers, and support delivery cadence.
  • Product Communication & Strategic Thinking: Be a direct, clear communicator who can articulate priorities and say ‘no’ when needed. Protect the product from scope creep, stakeholder appeasement, or feel-good but low-impact projects.
  • Align, but Don’t Please: Collaborate effectively with stakeholders while prioritizing product quality and outcomes over consensus or politics. Communicate hard decisions without soft-pedaling.
  • Contribute to Product Culture: Raise the bar for quality, execution, and decision-making in a fast-paced startup environment. Help instill clarity, urgency, and discipline in the way we build.

What We’re Looking For

  • Customer-obsessed: You always start with the user and are proactive about talking to them. You’ve used our platform - or would have - before applying.
  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in SaaS, consumer subscription, or health tech.
  • Highly data-driven: You can track and act on business and user metrics and apply analytical rigor to prioritize effectively.
  • Proven track record of shipping and scaling consumer products, particularly subscription-based platforms.
  • Strategic mindset: You can connect high-level goals with actionable plans, and keep long-term vision front and center.
  • Mission-driven: You’re excited by the potential of genomics and motivated by real impact.
  • Exacting standards: You push for excellence and aren’t afraid to raise the bar.
  • Resilient to pushback: You don’t fold under pressure and remain firm when decisions are right.
  • Direct communicator: You value clarity over ambiguity and fairness over comfort.
  • Executional excellence: You have the organizational skills to juggle multiple initiatives while delivering results.
  • Builder’s mentality: You earn respect through work product, not charm, and lead through doing.
  • Respect without people-pleasing: You collaborate well but don’t need universal approval to drive results.

About Sequencing

Sequencing is powering the future of personalized health. We are the platform that transforms a person’s genome into a lifelong source of straightforward, actionable insights - for individuals, families, and healthcare professionals. By providing the application layer to your DNA, we turn complex genetic data into recurring value throughout every stage of life.

Our unique, clinical-grade Whole Genome Sequencing unlocks the most complete view of your DNA, screening for almost all known health conditions, traits, and medication responses - and translating that information into clear, actionable steps for managing health risks, optimizing wellness, and extending longevity.

As whole genome sequencing becomes a standard part of life, Sequencing is already the trusted platform where people safely store their DNA data - and will become the lifelong home for every genome on Earth.

We’re a fully remote, global team of innovators, scientists, and builders, united by a mission to make genomics accessible, actionable, and life-changing for everyone.

Proudly named GenomeWeb’s Best Place to Work in 2024, Sequencing is venture-backed and scaling rapidly to meet surging demand in the fast-growing personal genomics market.

If you’re excited to help redefine how the world thinks about health, join us in building the platform that brings every genome to life.

Nós sabemos que na construção de uma sociedade mais forte a evolução deve vir de dentro para fora . Por isso, um ambiente acolhedor e com o sentimento constante de pertencimento é fundamental para o crescimento individual e coletivo.

O esforço é de todos nós, e as conquistas também. Porque ser um MJVer é bem mais do que ser um colaborador: é sobre fazer parte.

Somos colaborativos, ágeis, plurais, criativos e inovadores. Somos MJV!

Profissional de prospecção enterprise dedicado a uma conta única e estratégica do setor de energia. Foco em ABM e geração de reuniões qualificadas com gestores-chave, posicionando a MJV como consultoria estratégica.

Responsabilidades

  • Mapear stakeholders-alvo (gerentes setoriais, diretores e compras).
  • Orquestrar cadências multicanal (LinkedIn, e-mail, telefone, WhatsApp Business).
  • Agendar e confirmar reuniões qualificadas; participar das reuniões com o head da frente comercial, que conduz a conversa.
  • Registrar tudo no CRM, manter pipeline hygiene e follow-ups estruturados.
  • Produzir call notes e next steps acionáveis pós-reunião.

  • Volume e qualidade de reuniões qualificadas agendadas.
  • Cobertura de stakeholders e avanço por etapa da cadência.
  • Aderência a playbook, disciplina de CRM e consistência de follow-up.
  • Geração de insights comerciais e intel da conta.

title: Job Page | 1502985 - ENFERMEIRO DO TRABALHO
description:
Faça Parte do Time Med+ e Transforme Vidas!

Se você é um profissional comprometido, apaixonado pela área da saúde e segurança e deseja fazer a diferença, o Grupo Med+ é o lugar certo para você!

Somos movidos pela missão de salvar vidas e acreditamos profundamente em nosso propósito de transformar a terceirização de mão de obra no Brasil, convertendo recursos humanos em pessoas felizes.

Somos referência nacional no fornecimento de terceirização de Emergency Response para infraestruturas críticas, atuando em três pilares essenciais: Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho, Urgência e Emergência, Prevenção e combate a incêndios.

Você se identifica com a nossa empresa? Então essa é a sua chance!

Venha fazer parte do nosso time e ser um Med Member.

"Assessorar, planejar, gerir e realizar acompanhamento e monitoramento dos trabalhadores na “Trilhado do Cuidado Continuado”;

Assessorar, planejar, gerir e realizar acompanhamento e monitoramento dos trabalhadores com diagnóstico de transtorno mental em periodicidade definida pela PETROBRAS;

Assessorar, planejar, gerir e realizar acompanhamento e monitoramento dos trabalhadores com histórico de dependência química e tabagismo em periodicidade definida pela PETROBRAS;

Assessorar, planejar, gerir e realizar acompanhamento e monitoramento dos trabalhadores impactados por situações de violência no trabalho em periodicidade definida pela PETROBRAS;

Assessorar, planejar, gerir e realizar acompanhamento e monitoramento dos trabalhadores após acidente de trabalho e/ou doença ocupacional em periodicidade definida pela PETROBRAS;

Desenvolver suas atividades pautadas em conceitos de Cuidado Centrado na Pessoa, Segurança e Experiência do Paciente;

Atuar em equipe multiprofissional na elaboração de “plano de cuidado” para os trabalhadores, de acordo com os fatores de risco individuais mapeados;

Assessorar, planejar, gerir e realizar atendimento de forma individual ou em grupo;

Assessorar, planejar, gerir e realizar ações de cuidado, recuperação, prevenção e promoção da saúde dos trabalhadores de acordo com perfil epidemiológico do público-alvo;

Promover saúde no ambiente de trabalho através de ações colaborativas, especializadas e multidisciplinares para toda força de trabalho;

Realizar análise crítica, propor, planejar e gerir melhorias no engajamento dos empregados no programa de saúde mental e na melhoria dos indicadores de saúde, no seu âmbito de atuação;

Realizar acompanhamento individual interdisciplinar e multiprofissional a empregados ativos e afastados;

Realizar análises epidemiológicas e ações de vigilância em saúde, incluindo notificação às secretarias municipais de saúde de sua área de abrangência, sobre as doenças de notificação compulsória;

Formular relatórios e pareceres técnicos sobre assuntos de sua especialidade, quando demandado;

Elaborar material, proferir palestras e atuar em práticas educativas sobre temas relacionados a saúde, tendo como público-alvo, lideranças, força de trabalho, profissionais de saúde/Recursos Humanos;

Registrar as informações e atendimento em formulários próprios e/ou sistemas informatizados;

Realizar outras atribuições descritas na Lei nº 7.498/86 e suas alterações, Decreto nº 94.406/87, bem como às demais normas emitidas pelo Conselho Federal de Enfermagem (COFEN), Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN), Normas Regulamentadoras do Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego (NR’s) e legislação vigente aplicável."

Especialização em Enfermagem do Trabalho reconhecido pelo MEC.

Situação regularizada no Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN) da respectiva localidade em que atua."

Treinamento em Biossegurança ou NR32.

Possuir habilidades nos sistemas informatizados, incluindo pacote office, dentre outros sistemas utilizados pela Petrobras.

Experiencia mínima de 6 (seis) anos na atividade de enfermagem do trabalho.

Possuir experiência mínima de 2 (dois) anos em gestão do cuidado, atuação na rede básica de saúde e/ou em saúde do trabalhador e aplicação da sistematização da assistência de enfermagem."

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Pleno (GloboID) – Globo – Rio de Janeiro
description:
Overview

Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Pleno (GloboID) – Globo – Rio de Janeiro

A GloboID é a plataforma de identidade da Globo, responsável por autenticar e autorizar milhões de acessos diariamente em nossos produtos digitais, incluindo o Globoplay. Nosso time atua criando a fundação para os demais times da Globo, impulsionando o desenvolvimento de software e garantindo que as soluções de identidade sejam seguras, escaláveis e inovadoras.

Trabalhamos com desafios que vão desde a construção de APIs robustas até a integração com grandes parceiros e sistemas complexos, sempre com foco em qualidade, performance e experiência do usuário.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com profissionais altamente qualificados, em um ambiente dinâmico, com espaço para aprender, ensinar e evoluir junto com a gente. Se você gosta de resolver problemas complexos, trabalhar com tecnologias modernas e contribuir para soluções que impactam milhões de pessoas, o GloboID é o seu lugar!

Diversidade:

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido – RJ, SP, BH, Brasília, Recife ou POA.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução dos sistemas da plataforma de identidade, garantindo qualidade, performance e segurança;
  • Compreender e aplicar as regras de negócio relacionadas ao domínio em que atua, prestando suporte técnico para outros times que dependem das aplicações sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Planejar e executar tarefas de forma autônoma, contribuindo para o cumprimento dos objetivos do trimestre (OKRs) e acompanhando seu andamento;
  • Identificar débitos técnicos e avaliar trade-offs entre possíveis soluções, buscando equilíbrio entre prazo e qualidade;
  • Colaborar com colegas, apoiando desenvolvedores menos experientes e compartilhando conhecimento;
  • Revisar código, realizar testes e manter documentação técnica e de negócio atualizada;
  • Participar de discussões de projeto e contribuir para decisões técnicas e de arquitetura.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de software em ambiente colaborativo, preferencialmente com metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento sólido de linguagens e frameworks utilizados no ecossistema da GloboID (GoLang, React, MongoDB, Google Cloud Platform);
  • Capacidade de compreender e aplicar regras de negócio e requisitos funcionais;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e revisão de código (code review);
  • Noções de testes automatizados e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, comunicar-se de forma clara e pedir ajuda quando necessário;
  • Capacidade de planejar e executar tarefas de forma autônoma.

Conhecimentos que te destacam

  • Experiência com sistemas de autenticação, autorização ou plataformas de identidade (CIAM);
  • Conhecimentos sobre RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) e padrões de segurança para APIs;
  • Experiência com microsserviços, mensageria e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Conhecimento de observabilidade e monitoramento de aplicações (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.);
  • Vivência com práticas DevOps e pipelines de integração/entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Experiência em refatoração e otimização de código legado;
  • Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas ou projetos open source.

title: ENFERMEIRO NAVEGADOR - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

Hospital Cardoso Fontes é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsável pela gestão eficiente e eficaz da equipe de enfermagem dos setores de internação e emergência, promovendo a padronização do serviço, a qualidade no atendimento ao paciente, a segurança dos processos assistenciais e o cumprimento das normas e protocols estabelecidos. Auxiliar na coordenação das atividades da equipe de enfermagem, implementar programas de treinamento e capacitação, otimizar recursos e garantir a integração entre as áreas da instituição, visando a excelência no cuidado e a melhoria contínua dos processos de enfermagem.

Requisitos

Graduação em Enfermagem com especialização ou residência.

Curso de Gestão de Pessoas e Liderança; Especialização em Saúde Pública; Especialização em Urgência/Emergência/CTI; Gestão de Serviços de Saúde.

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Registro ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ ou Barra da Tijuca/RJ

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Nossas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, estendendo-se para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Clinical Trial Nurse - Per Diem Porto Alegre, BR
description:
Are you a Registered Nurse interested in Clinical Trial work?

IQVIA is looking for qualified Registered Nurses interested in community and clinical trial work to visit clinical trial patients in their homes. You will be responsible for going to patient homes to assist with conducting research, collecting data and samples to help evaluate safety/efficacy of a new medication.

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

As an Adobe Gold Solution Partner, LeapPoint’s expertise spans the entire Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem. The company’s certified consultants have delivered more than 600,000 hours of Adobe-related implementations and integrations and actively support hundreds of enterprise-level clients. LeapPoint is part of Omnicom’s precision marketing division, Omnicom Precision Marketing Group (OPMG). OPMG is a global network of agencies and consultancies spanning CRM, customer experience design, and marketing technology and business consulting. LeapPoint is seeking an AEM Practice Lead to deliver on our vision of Connected Work, where we help clients understand, design, and build a connected ecosystem of platforms that drive hyper-personalization, data-driven decisions, and successful outcomes. In this role, you will lead a team of AEM Architects and Developers, oversee the delivery of high-impact Adobe Content Supply Chain Solution implementations, and serve as a trusted advisor to our clients. You will drive technical excellence, shape practice strategy, and ensure alignment with Adobe’s MarTech ecosystem, fostering growth for both our clients and our company.

Responsibilities

  • Practice Leadership: define and execute the strategic vision for the AEM Services practice, including service offerings, delivery methodologies, and team development.
  • Project Oversight: lead end-to-end delivery of AEM Solutions, ensuring quality, timeliness, and alignment with client goals; manage scope, risks, and resources effectively.
  • Client Engagement: act as a senior consultant and subject matter expert, advising clients on AEM best practices, digital transformation strategies, and integration with Adobe Experience Cloud (e.g., Analytics, Target, Campaign).
  • Team Management: mentor and grow a high-performing team of AEM professionals, fostering technical expertise, collaboration, and career development.
  • Solution Design: architect scalable, robust AEM solutions that are integrated with the Content Supply Chain and tailored to client needs, including features such as multi-site and multi-channel delivery, personalization/ targeting, content aggregation & syndication, multi-lingual support, automated workflow management, social media, etc.
  • Business Development: collaborate with sales and marketing teams to identify opportunities, craft proposals, and pitch AEM solutions to prospective clients.
  • Innovation & Standards: stay ahead of AEM and Adobe MarTech trends, driving adoption of new features (e.g., AEM as a Cloud Service, Edge Delivery Services) and establishing reusable frameworks or accelerators.
  • Partnerships: strengthen relationships with Adobe and other technology partners to enhance our practice capabilities and certifications.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Main responsibilities
